newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Bank/Portugal seen making no rate change.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Bank/Portugal seen making no rate change.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal was not expected to make any change to its money market rates when it announces terms for the next commercial bank reserve period on Wednesday, according to a Reuter poll of 10 analysts.
The analysts said that the worse than expected inflation figures for May and some lingering nervousness about the single currency would deter the central bank from making any move.
The repo rate stands at 6.0 percent, while the drain, or absorption rate, which is what the Bank pays for funds it drains from the market, is currently 5.7 percent.

The National Statistics Institute (INE) said on Tuesday that the consumer price index rose 0.7 percent month-on-month in May, up from 0.2 percent in April, taking the year-on-year rate to 2.1 percent against 1.8 percent previously.
Analysts had been forecasting a year-on-year rate of 1.4-1.8 percent for May.

The following banks and brokers taking part in the poll were prepared to be identified: Banco Portugues de Investimento; Banco Mello de Investimentos; IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros; Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais; Fincor; Credit Lyonnais; Banco de Comercio e Industria; Banco Finantia; Banco Essi.
